caseName: Director of Revenue v. CoBank ACB
caseNameFull: Director of Revenue of Missouri v. CoBank ACB, as Successor to the National Bank for Cooperatives

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Mo. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: “Does 12 U. S. C. §2134 authorize States to tax the income of the National Bank for Cooperatives, a federally chartered instrumentality of the United States?”
